item.title: Theories and ideas log
item.description:
Separate from [[logs/companies]] and [[logs/conspiracies]]. Dates are first clear documented appearance of the idea, not “the idea became a product.”

When Idea Status Pages
Late 18th c. Graphite is elemental carbon, not lead Well-supported consensus [[timeline/pre-chemistry]]
1859 Graphite oxidized into a lamellar oxide Well-supported [[timeline/before-1900]]
1947 Single graphite layer as a calculable electron system Well-supported theory [[timeline/1947]]
1960s–80s Strict 2D crystals vs Mermin–Wagner-type talk Often over-simplified in pop history [[timeline/1963-2003]]
1962 / 1986 Oxide-route monolayers; name graphene Well-supported [[timeline/1962]]
2004–2005 Isolated monolayer on insulator + Dirac-fermion transport Well-supported experiment [[timeline/2004]] · [[timeline/2005]]
2007+ Ideal-monolayer property comparisons as product copy Pedagogy vs marketing [[timeline/2007]]
2009+ Copper CVD as a wafer-scale path Well-supported process paper; yield still a problem [[timeline/2009]]
2010s Graphene replaces silicon Largely unmet engineering ideal [[timeline/2011]] · [[timeline/2012]]
2012+ The device is a van der Waals stack, not a lone FET Well-supported research program [[timeline/2012]]
2013+ Flagship-scale coordinated applications Well-supported as a program [[timeline/2013]]
2015 Holey graphene as molecular stencil on gold Well-supported method [[posts/holey-graphene-molecular-stencil]] · [[timeline/2015]]
2017 Shared vocabulary can exist across grades (ISO/TS 80004-13) Terminology standard, not a certificate [[timeline/2017]]
2018 Twist angle as a knob (magic-angle bilayer) Well-supported physics [[timeline/2018]]
